kinds.label: CRM records
kinds.note: Choose all contacts, all companies, all deals, or the deals of one pipeline. Companies are never created or edited, but notes can be logged on them. Minerva reaches what the HubSpot app's scopes allow, whatever the HubSpot permissions of the person who connected it.

operations.name: search_contacts
operations.title: Search contacts
operations.description: Search contacts, most recently changed first: by words, by exact email address, or by the company or deal they are associated with. HubSpot's search can lag a few seconds behind changes. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: get_contact
operations.title: Get a contact
operations.description: Get one contact. A contact merged into another is answered with the other, under its own id.

operations.name: search_companies
operations.title: Search companies
operations.description: Search companies, most recently changed first: by words, by exact domain, or by the contact or deal they are associated with. HubSpot's search can lag a few seconds behind changes. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: get_company
operations.title: Get a company
operations.description: Get one company. A company merged into another is answered with the other, under its own id.

operations.name: list_pipelines
operations.title: List deal pipelines
operations.description: List the deal pipelines you may see, with their stages in order.

operations.name: search_deals
operations.title: Search deals
operations.description: Search deals, most recently changed first: by pipeline, stage, words, or the contact or company they are associated with. Stages are ids from list_pipelines. Without a pipeline, only a search with no other filter covers deals in single allowed pipelines. HubSpot's search can lag a few seconds behind changes. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: get_deal
operations.title: Get a deal
operations.description: Get one deal: its pipeline, stage, amount, close date and description.

operations.name: create_contact
operations.title: Create a contact
operations.description: Create a contact. Email addresses are unique: search_contacts finds an existing one. HubSpot may also create and associate a company from the email address's domain.

operations.name: update_contact
operations.title: Update a contact
operations.description: Change a contact's email address, name, phone, company name or job title.

operations.name: create_deal
operations.title: Create a deal
operations.description: Create a deal in a pipeline and stage from list_pipelines, optionally associated with contacts and companies. HubSpot workflows may act on new deals.

operations.name: update_deal
operations.title: Update a deal
operations.description: Change a deal's name, stage, amount or close date. The stage must be in the deal's own pipeline; deals cannot be moved to another pipeline. HubSpot workflows may act on stage changes.

operations.name: add_note
operations.title: Log a note
operations.description: Log a plain-text note on one contact, company or deal; it shows in the record's activity timeline.
